title: Growth zero values retain denominators, counts agree, and the current page stays legible
steps: Run the statistics count tests and inspect the current pagination page contrast rule.
expect: Zero values render with their measured denominator and unit, including an empty cohort.
Counts use the singular or plural noun that agrees with each count.
The current pagination page and its hover state use foreground fill with background text.
fence: The tests fail if a zero loses its denominator, a count uses the wrong noun, or the active page loses its contrasting colors.

tests: zero counts retain their measured denominator, including an empty cohort
count nouns agree with their own count and support irregular plurals
current pagination page uses foreground fill and background text for contrast
